asked: Feature 395 session 2 (check and apply). Three source-reader units are owed a THIRD round on the same note: source-reader:0255#miyashiro-kumehara-1698-2, source-reader:0256#jindoh-2023-carpenter-budget, source-reader:0257#kitano-2026-osaka-day-labor-2. Rounds 1 and 2 were all READ, 0 CONTRADICTED. What moved since round 2 is new passages ADDED to each note to answer quote-check's PARTIAL findings (round 1 of quote-check): for miyashiro-2 the document heading 三一 文化十五年 諸職人規定 (the 1818 date); for jindoh the household-of-three sentence and the 5.4 x (354-60) days line; for kitano-2 the southern-outer-moat row (17.922 a tsubo, 押合) and three sentences of the paper's explanation of rows 8 and 12 and of 押合, plus a changed translation of row 8. The existing passages are unchanged. Proposed route: run source-reader round 3 on these three notes, told to read only the added passages and the changed row-8 translation, since quote-check round 2 will also read every note's quotes VERBATIM and SUPPORTS. Alternative: skip source-reader round 3 and let quote-check round 2 alone verify the added passages. Which?
why: This third round is owed because new source text entered the notes, not because findings recurred: rounds 1 and 2 were all READ, 0 CONTRADICTED, with no reversals and no oscillation, so this is convergence, not a loop. Quote-check's round-1 PARTIALs were answered by adding passages to the notes, which shows quote-check compares the question's quotes against the note, not the note against the scanned source; source-reader is the only check that puts the note's transcriptions beside the source, so skipping it would leave the added 文化十五年 heading, the household-of-three and 5.4 x (354-60) lines, the 17.922/押合 row, its three explanatory sentences and the changed row-8 translation read by no check, and would waive FR-002 for the passages most likely to carry a transcription error. No packing: no unresearched number is being defended here.
what: Run source-reader round 3 on source-reader:0255#miyashiro-kumehara-1698-2, source-reader:0256#jindoh-2023-carpenter-budget and source-reader:0257#kitano-2026-osaka-day-labor-2, each told to read ONLY the added passages (and for kitano-2 the changed row-8 translation) against the source; the passages already READ in rounds 1-2 stand and are not re-opened. Name the page-image files in each prompt (the s1 handoff records a source-reader that could not list images/ and guessed names). Dispatch quote-check round 2 beside it, not instead of it. Apply round 3's findings once; any further round on these notes is a new arbiter trigger, not a re-dispatch under this ruling.
tooling_fix: make check-bundle FOR=source-reader should list the bundle's images/ files by name in its MANIFEST and include the unit's note diff since its last recorded round, so a re-read after added passages is scoped, and its pages findable, by the tool rather than by hand in the prompt.

asked: Feature 395: session 2 ran two rounds of quote-check, record-format, translation-check, source-applicability and source-reader on 0255-0258 and applied them; hand fixes made after round 2 (commit 211e47dfc, the round-2 findings that came back EDIT: none) now owe a THIRD round: quote-check 43 units (nearly all 'a block carrying this note changed', previous verdict SUPPORTS), record-format 4, translation-check 5, source-reader 3, source-applicability 1 (saito-1993). Continue with a third round on all of them, a third round scoped to the units whose own note or quotation text changed (source-reader 3, translation-check 5, source-applicability 1, record-format 4) with the 43 block-changed quote-check units accepted on their round-2 SUPPORTS, or accept?
why: The fixes after round 2 put text in front of readers that no check has read: a new quotation (the Ikoma 14.4), a new hedge (the 17.9 that takes in the wall trench), a corrected registry claim (saito-1993's 60 monme), the round-2 translation fixes (apportionment, Nishiwa, canal, [Edo], oban gloss) and the 0256/0257 PARTIAL fixes, so accepting them unread is not a waiver of repeated wording. But 'a block carrying this note changed' is not a change to a unit whose own quotation and claim stand as round 2 found them SUPPORTS, so a full round on all 43 would buy nothing; this applies to every check the same scope the earlier ruling ask:395-source-reader-round3 applied to source-reader (the added text only), and the findings converge with nothing reversing. Three tooling fixes from earlier rulings (archive-inbox size refusal, ledger-owed scoping, check-bundle image listing) are still unbuilt by the session's own evidence; the contract has them made, with tests, before the next tick.
what: Round 3, scoped to changed text and nothing else: record-format on its 4, translation-check on its 5, source-applicability on saito-1993, source-reader on its 3, each shown only the text changed since its round 2 (the 211e47dfc diff). Of the 43 quote-check units, round 3 goes only to those whose own quotation text, or the claim sentence it supports, changed in 211e47dfc - for example the newly quoted Ikoma 14.4, the 17.9 hedge, the saito-1993 60-monme sentence, and the 0256/0257 PARTIALs fixed after round 2; every quote-check unit re-owed only because its enclosing block changed stands on its round-2 SUPPORTS, and the session records that disposition, citing this ruling, for each of them. A round-3 finding is fixed and is not dispatched again: what it leaves is filed as a row. This is not packing: it is a research record and no number fixes room.
tooling_fix: make record-owed (and ledger-owed, which computes what a check owes) should re-owe quote-check on a unit only when the unit's own quotation text or the claim sentence it supports changes, not when any other note in the block that carries it changes.

note: archive-inbox: an inbox entry over GitHub's 100 MB file limit waits in the inbox even once matched and never reaches a commit (REFUSED line names a PDF split or the GM's LFS decision); ledger-owed WRITE=specs/NNN-... outside a page session writes only the passes traced to that feature (test_ledger_owed.py::test_a_write_naming_a_feature_writes_only_the_passes_traced_to_it)

check-bundle KEY= (IMAGES=<files|dir>) copies a scanned source's page images into images/ and lists each by name in the MANIFEST; a source-reader key bundle shows each owed note's diff since the last commit before its latest source-reader round

quote-check answers now also keep a reading - the note's words and the sentences carrying its mark (record_units.claims_of/reading_of; record_owed.answer keeps it) - so a unit answered once is not owed again when only another note's sentence in its block changes; its own claim sentence or note still re-owes it.
